title: rclpy and asyncio: no running event loop, hung service calls, and the thread bridge that works
excerpt: await asyncio.sleep() in an rclpy callback raises 'no running event loop'. await call_async() hung on a SingleThreadedExecutor until the callback was in a ReentrantCallbackGroup. For real asyncio, run rclpy.spin in a thread. Measured on Humble and Jazzy.
